messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] service=realtime-decode | metric=p99_latency | value=1240ms | threshold=800ms | region=us-west-2 :rotating_light:
Maya Chen: seeing this now, p95 up ~350ms too. lots of streaming stalls, customers hitting errors 504 on long responses. tagging @oncall-sre
Omar Patel: digging into logs, looks correlated with kernel image `gpu-runtime:v3.4.0` that rolled at 4829990000. TRT8 patch + FlashAttention update in that build.
Lee Kim: +1, we started noticing tail after the TRT8-compat compile flags landed. stack traces show heavier page faults during KV cache loads.
Ignacio Ruiz: any quick fallback? can we switch traffic to the previous node pool?
Maya Chen: yes we can route to the legacy pool (gpu-runtime:v3.3.9) but need a safe cordon/evict plan for stateful pods. I can start a canary redirect at 5% if folks agree.
Devon Shaw: do it. also add model-fallback to quantized variant for streaming-heavy customers as short-term mitigation. patch in console: set route policy -> fallback_model=redwood/decoder-quant-v2
Omar Patel: orchestrator logs show host-level compilepath errors: "compile_kernel: failed to allocate shadow pages" around the same timestamps. suspect a kernel allocation behavior change in v3.4.0.
oncall-sre: creating incident in incidents channel with SEV=2, linking this thread.
Maya Chen: rolling canary to legacy pool now: `kubectl patch svc realtime-decode -p '{"spec": {"selector": {"pool": "legacy"}}}'` (will monitor p95/p99 for next 2 mins)
deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout to node-pool=legacy (5% traffic) by Maya Chen at 4832101268
Lee Kim: watching metrics — p95 dropped ~80ms after canary, p99 still elevated but trending down. when can we cut more?
Ignacio Ruiz: we should do a small kernel rollback on a subset of infra too. I'll prepare the rollback image (gpu-runtime:v3.3.9) and a drainer job. ETA 15m.
Maya Chen: agree, also toggling `ENABLE_FLASHATTN_OPT` to false on one cluster to validate impact. command:
```
kubectl set env daemonset/gpu-runtime ENABLE_FLASHATTN_OPT=false -n infra
```
Omar Patel: stack dumps from affected pods attached show hot loops in `decode_attention()` after kernel upgrade. memory mappings are different (anon hugepages falling back).
Devon Shaw: customer success ping: CS reported 2 customers with production impact, both streaming large contexts. informing them we're rolling back and using model fallback for now :phone:
Ignacio Ruiz: rollback started on canary subset. I'll coordinate node draining: `gcloud compute instances update --metadata-from-file ...` - will avoid rolling control plane boxes.
Maya Chen: after 10m, p99 down from 1240ms -> 720ms on canary. good sign. pushing to 30% traffic ramp.
Lee Kim: we should capture a full perf profile before full rollback. Omar, can you capture `perf` and `nvprof` traces on an affected pod?
Omar Patel: on it. grabbing `perf record -F 99 -g -- sleep 60` and `nsys` traces for 60s.
oncall-sre: handoff note: if p99 remains >900ms at 4832101700 escalate to eng-runtime lead.
Devon Shaw: opening a tracking ticket INF-4823 with root-cause hypothesis: kernel allocation behavior change after TRT8/FlashAttention compile flags. attaching logs and preliminary perf samples.
Ignacio Ruiz: full rollback to v3.3.9 scheduled in waves: canary (done) -> 30% (in progress) -> 100% (target 4832101600).
Maya Chen: small gotcha: some workloads rely on new kernel driver improvements for nvlink. confirm no data-plane regressions after rollback. running canary smoke: embedding correctness, throughput tests.
Lee Kim: smoke passed on canary, no errors. telemetry shows decode correctness intact.
deploy-bot: rollout to 30% complete at 4832101510
Maya Chen: final cut to 100% queued, will proceed if p99 stays <850ms for next 5m.
Omar Patel: latest perf trace shows most samples in `page_fault_handler` and `kv_cache_fetch` - allocation path looks more aggressive with v3.4.0. pointing to compile-time allocator flags.
Devon Shaw: note for postmortem: check `-DHEAP_SHRINK_THRESHOLD` and `-DFLASHATTN_FASTPATH` flags used in the v3.4.0 build. also evaluate TRT8 auto-tune knobs applied.
Ignacio Ruiz: 100% rollback complete at 4832101620. cluster p99 stabilized at ~680ms. marking incident mitigated for customer impact.
Maya Chen: thanks team. I'll stay on thread to hand off to night oncall. next steps: write up timeline, attach traces, and open a build-gate for kernel image v3.4.0 until we've validated allocator changes.
oncall-sre: handing off to night oncall (Lee Kim) at 4832101830. Lee, please monitor p99 for next 6 hours and let oncall-sre know if any regression.
Lee Kim: acknowledged. I'll keep watch and start a follow-up runbook item to block v3.4.0 on production until patch. :white_check_mark:
Maya Chen: creating postmortem draft and will ping eng-runtime for RCA session tomorrow. thanks everyone. :pray:
